notes: Mesh consists of multiple separate plank and frame components

blind.description: A stylized wooden picnic table featuring a tabletop made of four wooden planks and two attached side benches. The structure is supported by angled wooden A-frame style legs connected by crossbeams. The surfaces are smooth, beveled, solid, and continuous with stylized wood textures in warm medium brown. It stands directly on its four feet without any added base plate.
blind.from_above: A rectangular composition showing the central tabletop composed of four parallel wooden planks, flanked along both long edges by single-plank bench seats.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 feet tall (less than half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 5 to 6 feet long.
